title: ghatakarpara — ghat-p01-v05
question: The cātaka, gasping, begs for rain — and nothing else.
issue: Derived from L2 text (no argmap). The cātaka, gasping, begs for rain — and nothing else.

premises.text: manmathe ca hṛdi hantum udyate proṣitapramadayedam udyate nirdayena paradeśasevinā māriṣyatha hi tena māṃ vinā anyadeśaratir adya mucyatāṃ sāthavā tava vadhūḥ kim ucyatām cātakaś ca tṛṣito 'mbu yācate duḥkhitā pathika sā priyā ca te ambudaiḥ śikhigaṇo vinādyate kā ratiḥ priya mayā vinādya te toyadāgamakṛśā ca sādya te durdhareṇa madanena sādyate śokasāgarajale ca pātitāṃ tvadguṇasmaraṇam eva pāti tām dravati ca kaluṣaṃ jalaṃ nadīnāṃ kim iti ca māṃ samavekṣase na dīnām gambhīramegharasitavyathitā kadāhaṃ jahyāṃ sakhi priyaviyogajaśokadāhaṃ
